test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: How much time will it take for a sum of ₹ 900 to yield ₹ 810 as interest at 5% per annum of simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = 900

Simple Interest (SI) = 810

Rate of interest = 5%

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, R = Rate 

**Calculation:**

Let the time needed is T years

According to the question,

810 = (900 × 5 × T)/100

⇒ 45T = 810

⇒ T = 810/45

⇒ T = 18

So, Time = 18 years

**∴ The required time is 18 years.**
